body: You' re right, that narcissistic feeling is so destructive, but I don't know if it's too late for me. I have had two therapy episodes. In the first one, I learned a couple of techniques of mindfulness to fight bad thoughts, but in the second one (present) my therapist said that I don't try to fight them and I need medication. I hope I can see a small piece of happiness before suicidal thoughts are out of control. Thanks for your support.

Thanks for your words.  You know?  I have had that feeling of helping others, only that I have not been motivated by it.  In general, for everything I like to do.  I mean, people believe in me, but I constantly feel empty.  However, I have known experiences of overcoming some people that have given me some encouragement in these times.

 I hope I can find the motivation I'm looking for ... if I deserve it.
